There is now a media feeding frenzy around the revelations of Jensen Huang’s admitted affair with a suspected PRC spy, sales to Megaspeed, and improper meddling into investigations into Megaspeed. Each new story looks worse for Nvidia executives and for the US Department of Commerce. It is a perfect storm of hubris, salaciousness, espionage, greed and corruption. And I believe there is much more to come. 

My understanding is that the allegations about Huang and his girlfriend were very tightly held inside the US government. It would be very interesting to learn who leaked it and why now, so close to Trump’s meeting with Xi at APEC.

items.excerpt: The European Union has accused TikTok of breaching its digital rules. The EU says TikTok's algorithm recommends videos that could harm mental health and body image. The bloc's executive arm wants TikTok to change its “For You” feed design to give users more control. Regulators say TikTok's recommendation system leads users into “rabbit holes” of similar, potentially harmful content. TikTok hasn't responded yet. The company can respond before the European Commission issues a final decision, which could include a fine. This is part of the EU's enforcement under the Digital Services Act, which aims to clean up tech platforms.
items.title: EU accuses TikTok of DSA breach over 'rabbit hole' video feed harming well-being
